sourceDesign.provenanceNote: U20 (PAF-225) provenance. The tracked .pen was opened only through Pencil MCP Get/Export (read-only, not modified). Each of the nine frames was exported individually at scale 1 and read frame by frame; the summary screenshot was not used. D7: route-specific frames win and BcpYH is the confirmed group detail (/matches/$eventId/groups/$groupId), not the /matches/past list.

precedence: D7: BcpYH = ConfirmedGroupDetail. Route-specific frames (GrkSH pair, khmeK opponent, o9iaC1 community) govern their own pages; RN0yw/RRuhH/z6vIR/QVLTH split the player statistics page into sections; m8Loju is the shared filters region. The match history LIST has no frame of its own (w25dY belongs to U11): it takes the history card rhythm only.

PlayerStatistics.note: Page background with 20px gutters and 14px rhythm; 21/800 title with the real subtitle and filter context chips; three 20px hairline tiles (24/800 values), 20px W-L-D strip, 17/800 section titles, sections in 20px hairline cards. The metric inventory (rating, activity chart, records) stays: all real data. The real URL form remains inline after highlights, recent form and recent matches so the first viewport leads with results.

CommunityStatistics.note: Same page and card treatment; match totals precede the real inline form, with filter chips and 48px controls. Frame figures "Avg. level" and "Most active venue" have no source (D6) and are omitted; Competitive and played counts, active players and the month/week charts remain. A share is derivable from the counts, but this pass does not add that figure.

PlayerMetric.note: Section = 17/800 title above a 20px hairline SurfaceCard; Stat tile = 20px hairline tile with 24/800 value; rows use 14px muted labels and 17/800 values.

PlayerStatisticsRecords.note: Set patterns and record cards in the same card/row rhythm; partner and opponent record lists keep their real columns.

PlayerRecentMatches.note: Recent matches stay one 20px hairline card per match with 44px+ links (RN0yw recent history rows); the frame shows form squares only, the real list stays.

MatchHistory.note: No dedicated frame (w25dY is the Matches list owned by U11): history rows take the hairline 20px card rhythm, 16/800 outcome and 14px meta; filters of the list are not invented (D6).

ConfirmedGroupDetail.note: D7: BcpYH = confirmed group detail. Light 20px scorecard presents two team rows with scoped set columns, independent green-soft outcome notice, 28/800 title, status chips, hairline cards for players, sets, matchup, confirmation and the audit timeline. "Request a correction" and "Share" have no source on this route (D6) and are not added.

PartnerRecords.note: Partner list inside one 20px hairline card; rows keep their real links and figures.

OpponentRecords.note: Opponent list inside one 20px hairline card; rows keep their real links and figures.

PairStatistics.note: Compact top bar (back chevron + 21/800 title) leads into the two-player composition (initials avatars, plus, other player's name and caption) and three headline tiles (matches, W-L-D, win rate; unavailable win rate renders the typed reason), then recent meetings, then the filter section and the detailed record cards (20px).

OpponentStatistics.note: Two-player composition and three tiles (meetings, W-L-D, set diff) lead, then recent meetings, with exact filters and detailed head-to-head evidence still available below.

RelationshipList.note: Recent meetings: hairline 20px cards with Won/Lost chip text, date and set scores; Show more is a 48px outlined control.

RelationshipMeetings.note: Meeting rows in the same card; link to the confirmed group detail unchanged.

RelationshipRecordView.note: Shared record sections (record, scores, streaks, rating, leagues) as 20px hairline cards with 14px muted labels and 17/800 values.

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Chromium 390×844, device scale 1, light English. Compute unmasked 390px-wide diagnostic bands separately. Gate only a 32×20 crop at x=0 and card-top+22, independently aligned on the Pencil and live card. Crop contains background, hairline and empty card padding, not sample copy or controls. Live gutter, radius and hairline width are asserted separately. A narrow edge comparison does not certify the full viewport.

GrkSH.note: Re-measured after the two-person composition and three tiles were restored. Bands realigned to the frame regions (header 0-104, composition+tiles 104-257, rest 257-844); they are not comparable to the earlier 104-355 band. The remaining primary residual is the live breadcrumb/title/filter chips/back link above the composition, which push it below the frame's single top bar.

khmeK.note: Re-measured after the two-person composition and three tiles were restored. Bands realigned to the frame regions (header 0-104, composition+tiles 104-257, rest 257-844); they are not comparable to the earlier 104-473 band. The remaining primary residual is the live breadcrumb/title/filter chips/back link above the composition.

browserBaselines.player-error-state.png: Chromium full-page snapshot of an invalid UTC date range. No approved Pencil frame depicts this error.
